preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S is a lowercase Latin letter or a digit.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(S.count(c) * (S.count(c) - 1) // 2 for c in set(S))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of ordered pairs (i, j) such that S[i] = S[j], where 1 ≤ i, j ≤ N.
